claim: Proposal-menu step 1i (gap M17, gateway half): POST /arrival/menu-evidence had no client in apps/web, apps/mobile or services on origin/main c93d6115c, so its handler, ArrivalService.menuEvidence and MenuEvidenceDto are deleted. No non-spec .ts file under apps/api-gateway/src names 'menu-evidence', 'menuEvidence' or 'MenuEvidenceDto', and arrival.controller.spec.ts reads the controller's route metadata and fails if the route, the service method or the DTO comes back. MenusService.previewArrivalMenu is kept (proposal steps 1a and 1c name it). Mutation-checked 2026-11-07: exit 1 against each of origin/main's three arrival files restored in turn.
verify: python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; r=pathlib.Path('apps/api-gateway/src'); c=(r/'arrival/arrival.controller.ts').read_text(); (r/'arrival/arrival.service.ts').read_text(); (r/'arrival/arrival.dto.ts').read_text(); t=(r/'arrival/arrival.controller.spec.ts').read_text(); src=[p for p in r.rglob('*.ts') if not p.name.endswith('.spec.ts')]; hits=[str(p) for p in src if any(k in p.read_text() for k in ('menu-evidence','menuEvidence','MenuEvidenceDto'))]; print(hits); sys.exit(0 if len(src)>100 and '@Controller(\"arrival\")' in c and not hits and 'menu-evidence' in t and 'MenuEvidenceDto' in t else 1)"
